run_query.description: Run a SQL query over the project's logs, spans and metrics and get the rows back. Needs a read token. Looks at the last 24 hours unless you give a time range.

parameters.description: A SQL query over the project's data, such as SELECT message FROM records WHERE is_exception. Logs and spans are in 'records'; metrics are in 'metrics'.
